'''Second Wind''' was a [[Cracian thumper]] who raced at the [[Heatherdowns Hotel and Track]]. During a race that occurred while the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] merchant [[Hamar-Chaktak]] met with a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents regarding a [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] theft, bookmakers gave Second Wind 7:1 odds.
